feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day weather forecast

items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 9 June 2026 5:29am
items.description:
##Today##

Sunny intervals and scattered blustery showers developing, these showers possibly heavy in places.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 9°C and max. air temperature 16°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

1-5, risk of 7 in places


##Wind Speed##

18


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

W or SW 15-20, soon increasing 20-25, occasional gusts of 30-35 near any heavier showers. Then veering W 15-20 in the evening, decreasing 10-15 overnight


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in showers.


##Comments##

Strong wind for a time.


##Tomorrow##

Sunny intervals and isolated showers. Then rain overnight.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 10°C and max. air temperature 15°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

0.5-3


##Wind Speed##

17


##Wind Direction##

W


##Wind##

W 10-15 occasionally 20 in places, backing S or SW 20-25 later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in precipitation. Hill fog at times.


##Comments##

Strong wind later.


##Thursday, 11 June 2026##

Rain at first, clearing through the afternoon to become mostly dry, with sunny intervals then developing.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 10°C and max. air temperature 15°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

5-10, risk of 15 on hills


##Wind Speed##

18


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

S or SW 20-25 occasionally 30-35 in places at first, soon veering W or SW 15-20, decreasing 10-15 overnight.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor becoming good later. Hill fog.


##Comments##

Strong wind at first.


##Friday, 12 June 2026##

Outbreaks of patchy rain or drizzle at first, soon becoming dry with bright or sunny intervals developing for a time.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 11°C and max. air temperature 16°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

0.5-2


##Wind Speed##

12


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

W or SW 10-15, backing S or SW later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain or drizzle. Hill fog at first soon becoming isolated.


##Comments##

Nil.


##Saturday, 13 June 2026##

Dry with sunny intervals but with a risk of coastal mist and fog patches in places.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 11°C and max. air temperature 17°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

0


##Wind Speed##

12


##Wind Direction##

S


##Wind##

S or SW 10-15, backing S or SE later.


##Visibility##

Mostly good, possibly poor or very poor in any mist and fog patches. Hill fog in places.

Nil.
